title: Creature features
blurb: Atomic-age monsters and flying saucers from the drive-in decade. Rubber suits, stock footage of jets, and the odd genuine classic hiding in the lineup.

films.note: The classic. A visitor, a robot, and a warning the world ignores. Klaatu barada nikto.
Ray Harryhausen's saucers take Washington apart, one monument at a time.
Rocks from space grow when wet and topple across the desert. Smarter than it sounds.
Dogs in shrew costumes. An island. A hurricane. Legendary for the costumes.
Corman-produced swamp horror with leeches the size of men. Sixty-two minutes.
Lobster monsters and a disintegrator ray on a $14,000 budget.
Peter Graves versus aliens with ping-pong-ball eyes. Made in a week.
An invisible alien loose in Los Angeles. The costume is a diving suit.
Lon Chaney Jr. is executed, revived, and very annoyed about it.
Giant spiders, a mad scientist, and a flamenco guitar score that never stops. Genuinely strange.
Lugosi turns a nightclub comic into a gorilla. It is exactly as good as the title.
Scientists drill to the centre of the earth to escape the atomic age. Earnest and odd.
